name: Taoqi

tierList.prydwen: Hybrid: T4 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 4-star Havoc Broadblade Skill DMG Amplifier/Shielder, considered bottom-tier despite a huge 38% Resonance Skill DMG Deepen Outro (relevant only for Jinhsi and Carlotta). Long, slow-animation rotation and a largely unusable Forte Circuit hurt overall usability.

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Concealed Edge (4 hits), Havoc.
skills.resonanceSkill: Fortified Defense - Havoc AoE + self-heal + 3 Rocksteady Shield stacks (party DMG reduction).
skills.forte: Power Shift - Timed Counters (Basic-Attack-type combo) consuming Resolving Caliber, generated from unused Rocksteady Shields.
skills.outro: Iron Will - 38% Resonance Skill DMG Deepen to next character for 14s or until swap.

echoSet: Rejuvenating Glow (best - 15% team ATK on heal)
Moonlit Clouds (special, 22.5% ATK to next character on Outro)

teams.name: Carlotta Team
teams.notes: Best DPS to support - nearly all Carlotta's damage is Resonance Skill DMG.

teams.name: Jinhsi Nuke Team
teams.notes: Not meta but produces huge damage-per-screenshot nukes; Verina needed for Coordinated Attacks to build Jinhsi's Forte.

rotation: Basic 1,2,3 (pre-rotation) -> Intro -> Timed Counter 1,2,3 -> Ultimate -> Basic 1-4 -> Skill -> Outro. Discord weapon strongly recommended to skip pre-rotation Basics.
communityNotes: Prydwen: bottom-tier overall due to a disjointed kit and one of the longest, most interruption-prone Support rotations in the game (long Broadblade wind-ups, unreliable parry-based Forte), but her Outro's 38% Skill DMG buff remains genuinely useful in Carlotta/Jinhsi nuke-focused teams - directly outclassed by Zhezhi in most other respects.
